# hostereo_project (Resource)

A project groups instances in the Hostereo console. The API cannot delete projects: `terraform destroy` only removes it from state (with a warning).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hostereo_project" "web" {
  name        = "web"
  description = "Front-end servers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Project name (max 64; letters, digits, spaces, underscores, dots, hyphens). Must be unique in your account.

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `instances_count` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import hostereo_project.web 7a2b1f4c-0e8d-4b3f-a5c4-9e3a1f2b6c77
```
